_comment: W1-T2901 — the CEILING on classes that `extend Error` DIRECTLY under tracked src/**/*.ts, held by test/error-subclass-census.test.ts. A recorded number is a ceiling, not a target: today's count is legal forever, but growing it is refused. Migrating a class onto the shared envelope (src/lib/errors.ts's `RmdError`, adopted first by PlanError in src/lib/plan.ts) does not lower this count by itself -- a subclass that now `extends RmdError` stops counting, but RmdError itself `extends Error` directly and is counted once, so the FIRST migration is a wash. Only migrations after the envelope already exists lower this number, one class at a time, by editing this file down in the same PR that moves the class off `extends Error`. Never raise this number to silence a red PR -- add a class without adopting the envelope only when the census test's own comment says growth is expected, and record the reason there. MEASURED 2026-09-08 via `git ls-files 'src/*.ts' | xargs grep -hoE 'class \w+ extends Error\b' | wc -l` on this checkout.
